code.name: FLUKA.cern
code.notes: Custom FLUKA source sampler and LET/dose user routine. Browser depth profiles exported from validated 150M post-processed CSVs.

frame.to_patient: Depth profiles are exported on the shared isocenter-referenced Z_narrow depth grid in cm, increasing downstream along the beam.

capabilities.notes: 150M browser export includes 1D Z_narrow dose, fluence, local/material LET, and selected water LET depth profiles. Local/material LET includes all charged particles, all protons, and primary protons. Water LET is exported for all protons and primary protons only. Relative-error columns are set to zero because per-bin statistical uncertainties are not carried by the current FLUKA post-processing CSVs.

outputs.notes: Exported from FLUKA 150M post-processed CSVs. Values are MeV/g/primary. Relative-error column is present but set to zero because the current post-processed FLUKA CSVs do not carry per-bin statistical uncertainties.

Exported from FLUKA 150M post-processed CSVs. Values are 1/cm^2/primary. Relative-error column is present but set to zero because the current post-processed FLUKA CSVs do not carry per-bin statistical uncertainties.

Exported from FLUKA 150M post-processed CSVs. Local/material LET values are MeV/cm. Relative-error column is present but set to zero because the current post-processed FLUKA CSVs do not carry per-bin statistical uncertainties.

Exported from FLUKA 150M post-processed CSVs. Water LET values are MeV/cm. Only proton and primary-proton water LET are exported here. Relative-error column is present but set to zero because the current post-processed FLUKA CSVs do not carry per-bin statistical uncertainties.
